description: Root cause of '32 failing bun tests': plain 'bun test' (no --isolate) leaks mock.module overrides across test files — 21 test files use mock.module (e.g. automations-new.test.tsx mocks ../lib/api-client globally, breaking run-actions.test.ts; axios default-adapter mocks stop reaching components). The package.json test script IS 'bun test --isolate' and CI invokes the script, so CI is green. Always use 'bun run test' in apps/fabro-web, never bare 'bun test'. Same for workflow scripts: smoke test_typescript stage fixed 2026-08-21 (commit 28265c0f7).
resolution: Verified: bun 1.3.14 'bun run test' = 807 pass / 0 fail; 'bun test' = 32 fail. Not bun-version-specific (1.3.13, 1.3.14, 1.4.0 all fail without --isolate). Smoke workflow + AGENTS.md corrected (commit 28265c0f7); seed fabro-e16c closed as not-a-bug.

name: slow-write-sandbox-forces-race-interleaving
description: Force async read-modify-write interleaving in tool tests with SlowWriteMockSandbox (write_delay_ms sleep in write_file): instant mock writes let the first future finish before the second polls, hiding races a regression test must prove. Pattern proven in fabro-agent write-lock tests (PR #787): test fails on main, passes with lock.

name: sentinel-contract-test
description: Sentinel contract tests for wiring structs: when an options struct carries a primary value and its fallback (e.g. PublishOptions.pr_resolved_model vs pr_model), every fixture MUST set DISTINCT sentinel values and the test asserts which one arrives at the consumer. a1e27c9bf shipped a mis-wiring that six tests could not catch because all fixtures used the same value for both fields. Same-value fixtures blind tests to field confusion.

Copy fixture patterns from the finalize.rs test mod (test_executed/test_run_options/test_services) BEFORE inventing new scaffolding; RunOptions is fabro-workflow's own type (not fabro_types), StageOutcome/Outcome come via fabro_types root re-exports.

fabro-cli unit test parse_auth_logout_all (bin/fabro) fails when FABRO_SERVER is set in the environment: it asserts args.server.server.is_none(), but the --server default resolves from FABRO_SERVER env. Reproduced 2026-09-08 in the dev agent session (FABRO_SERVER=http://127.0.0.1:32276); passes with 'env -u FABRO_SERVER'. Test should scrub/lock the env instead of assuming a clean shell.
resolution: open — filed as seed; test must scrub FABRO_SERVER env

description: Tests that inject a failure by chmod 0o000 on a fixture file silently pass their success path under root (fabro containers and CI run as uid 0, which bypasses file permission checks), making expect_err panic with '()'. Observed: fabro-dev spa_refresh publish_failure_before_flip_leaves_old_bundle_consistent failed the whole qualitygate in run 01M2YVNCFP5RDFCFRW9FS42R0B despite being green on developer hosts. Fix pattern: inject unreadability with a dangling symlink (fs::copy/files_match fail with ENOENT even for root) — planted AFTER a write_file has created the parent directory. Also: nextest reused a stale binary after edits twice; touch the source file to force a rebuild before re-diagnosing.
resolution: Replaced chmod 0o000 with a dangling symlink as the unreadable-source injector in publish_failure_before_flip_leaves_old_bundle_consistent (lib/foundation/fabro-dev/src/commands/spa_refresh.rs); test now fails the publish identically under root and unprivileged users.

name: Snapshot tests over async-supplemented event streams: wait, filter racers, normalize order numbers
description: Snapshot tests asserting a run/event stream tail go stale and FLAKY when an async supervisor appends records beside the terminal record (fabro run.branch_published races run.lifecycle; both arrival orders observed live). Deterministic pattern (fabro-0664 fix, 2026-09-30): (1) the test setup WAITS for every async record (wait_for_stream_item on the publish record), (2) the snapshot FILTERS the racing record line out entirely (whole-line regex incl. trailing newline - a pattern starting mid-line truncates garbage), (3) surviving seq/stream_seq numbers get normalized because they encode arrival order. Assert the terminal SET order-insensitively, never the last single event. Envelope corollary: a test env whose provider base_url is unset turns any model-calling stage into a 401 workflow_error - shape=box nodes are agent family (real model turn), parallelogram+script is the deterministic command family.

fork-catalog-overlay parallel model key collides with lithos built-ins: adding a NEW key (typesafe/jev-latest) for a model the built-in catalog already carries (openrouter jev-latest) is a DuplicateModelSelector — selectors (key + aliases) are unique per provider, the whole catalog build refuses, and the entire selection/catalog/client test set goes red, not just the new entry.
resolution: Override the built-in key in place: same-key rows merge recursively (arrays replace, sub-tables add), so pin api_model, add aliases, add the fabro kind marker; capabilities/pricing merge through (PR #339, 8e3dded73).

name: httpmock twin mechanics: substring bodies + call-count responses
description: httpmock 0.8: (1) json_body_includes parses its ARGUMENT as a JSON document and matches partial JSON — never pass a raw substring like 'model:jev' (panics: trailing characters); use body_includes for substring intent. (2) Two mocks whose matchers both fit every call do NOT sequence (httpmock serves the first match; the second mock never answers) — for a 500-then-200 retry twin use ONE mock with then.respond_with and an AtomicUsize call counter building HttpMockResponse::builder().status(..).body(..).build(). (3) Scope std Mutex guards before any .await in tests (clippy await_holding_lock). Evidence: judgment.rs twin tests, PR #339.

name: server-seam-wire-test-without-docker
description: create_run_with_bearer_for_graph + issue_test_run_tools_worker_token produce Worker-principal runs through the real HTTP API; dev-user bearer (auto-injected by build_test_router) provides the User-principal differential.

When mocking non-2xx fabro API responses in wire tests (httpmock or axum test doubles), the error body entries must include the full ErrorResponse shape INCLUDING the status field (e.g. {"errors":[{"status":"409","title":"Conflict","detail":"..."}]}). A body with only "detail" makes progenitor fail with 'Invalid Response Payload: missing field status', and the resulting error carries no parseable ApiFailure code/detail, so status-branching logic like fabro_client::api_failure_for-based retry-on-409 silently degrades to a generic failure. Observed in fabro-4f44 env_update wire tests (run 01M2ZKNKZVPBN3JM24SQDGVGBT): 409 mock with detail-only body bypassed the revision-race retry; adding status made classify_api_error attach ApiFailure{409} and the retry fired.
resolution: Always emit the full ErrorResponse entry (status+title+detail) in mocked error responses; the wire contract is docs/public/api-reference/fabro-api.yaml ErrorResponse, not a bare detail map.

name: httpmock-json-body-option-skip
description: When asserting a PUT body with httpmock .json_body() against a serde type whose Option fields use skip_serializing_if, the expected fixture must OMIT the key for None (structural equality treats missing != null). Observed in fabro-155b (run 01M2ZSYQR4ZM8N6HD67TT3AT3X): the replace-automation wire test failed with 'Request did not match any route or mock' because the fixture had "description": null while AutomationReplace serializes None as an absent key; also serde RunStatus fixtures need real PendingReason variants (approval_required, not queued).

fabro-server tests that execute runs in-process with default settings resolve the seeded 'default' environment (Docker provider) and hard-fail with WorkflowError 'Socket not found: /var/run/docker.sock' in Docker-less gate sandboxes (run 01M20T9S8JRXETASN64768TRRP: fabro-e505/fabro-c274 bridge tests). Pin such tests to the reserved local environment via '[run.environment] id = "local"' in the test TOML — Normal mode keeps real handler dispatch, unlike mode = "dry_run" which routes handlers to simulate() and silently skips execute-path assertions (empty observation vectors).
resolution: Both bridge tests pinned to id = "local"; full fabro-server suite 929/929 green without Docker; gate now environment-independent

description: Gate-red root cause (run 01M2G27BSCZSP0NASEVMH36PB9): the two fabro-server bridge tests (run_start_grants_github_token_bridge_only_to_user_principals, worker_principal_run_without_vault_token_takes_no_token_path) were the recurring 'Docker-socket failures' — they were the only tests driving a real in-process workflow to completion with the DOCKER-seeded default test environment, so any daemon-free gate environment fails them with 'Failed to build sandbox: Socket not found /var/run/docker.sock' before any handler dispatch. Verified pre-existing on the parent commit.
resolution: New test_app_state_with_runtime_settings_environment_and_registry_factory helper seeds LOCAL provider; bridge_intent_run switches the intent target to a leaked tempdir folder target because admission rejects none-targets on non-clone providers ('none targets require a compatible Docker or Daytona environment'). Both tests pass daemon-free; bridge observations unchanged.

description: fabro-server graph-render unit tests (server::tests::get_graph_returns_svg, render_graph_from_manifest_*) spawn 'fabro __render-graph' resolved via current_exe().parent().parent()/fabro (target/debug/fabro). The touched-crates qualitygate (scripts/qualitygate.nu) only builds/clippies touched crates, so when a run touches fabro-server without fabro-cli the binary is absent and these 3 tests fail deterministically (run 01M1VZTJSZ551NFPHPXD429MG0, tester stage).
resolution: Build 'cargo build -p fabro-cli --bin fabro' before gating fabro-server; root fix belongs in the gate (build the fabro bin when fabro-server is touched).

name: hermetic-provider-env-lookups
description: Hermetic provider-config env seams (fabro-2dac): production honors process env (OPENAI_BASE_URL layers above the [llm] overlay in fabro_llm::build_catalog; VaultCredentialSource::new owns the env fallback), tests must not. Two seams: fabro-server TestAppStateBuilder's default_env_lookup wraps the raw process lookup in hermetic_provider_env_lookup which scrubs OPENAI_BASE_URL; fabro-workflow InitOptions.env_lookup (fabro_auth::EnvLookup) is threaded into build_llm_source -> VaultCredentialSource::with_env_lookup, with start.rs passing process_env_var and every test constructor injecting Arc::new(|_| None) or a controlled map.

fs_globs_valid test asserted fixed diagnostic indices over graph.nodes.values() — but Graph.nodes is a HashMap with per-process random iteration order, so the test passed by luck and failed after an unrelated rewrite. Any new validate rule test asserting multi-node diagnostic ORDER must sort or use order-independent any()-assertions (established pattern: tools_requires_agent_node sorts node_ids).
resolution: Made the test order-independent (sort messages, any()-assertions).

name: terminal-source seeding for read-path tests
description: Out-of-band lifecycle appends do not re-fold a run projection: run_records::lifecycle (append+notify+settle) on a never-started run leaves the stored petri_projection at submitted — a submitted->failed jump is not folded because the projector consumes the petri stream, not synthetic platform-record jumps. Tests needing a terminal source seed the projection directly: load_petri_projection, flip status in memory, write_petri_run_row_on_connection + INSERT INTO petri_projection ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE — the fork_staleness_supervisor_tests.rs pattern, reused by the fabro-f93b fork-readiness pin.

The cargo suites and the workflow smokes can be fully green while the loop-asset BATTERY list stays red: sprint 23 landed the e71b fork feature with its fork-only pin file but no touchpoints registry row, so touchpoints-parity-fixtures.nu (a registered battery) red for days; the sprint-23 close only ran cargo rounds + a smoke and declared the gate healthy.
resolution: Before declaring a sprint or gate green, run EVERY battery named in scripts/qualitygate.nu (grep the smokes+batteries lists, run each with nu) — the parity batteries check registries, pins and cross-file invariants that no cargo test sees. cheap (~seconds) and catches the missing-row / missing-registration class.
